VghLantern__DocManagement__Config__Descr: System configuration overlay for the Document Management Mode project table. Merged over VghLantern__AppConfig__Main__.json by the ConfigLoader, so read every value through StateManager.VghLantern__StateManager__GetAppConfig() rather than fetching this file directly.

VghLantern__DocManagement__Config__Empty.Title: No Lantern Designs Yet
VghLantern__DocManagement__Config__Empty.Text: Start a design for a project in the Vale Projects Master Library, or add a new job to the library.

VghLantern__DocManagement__Config__NewPr.ManualModalTitle: New Lantern Design - Enter by Hand
VghLantern__DocManagement__Config__NewPr.ManualModalIntro: The job is added to the Vale Projects Master Library as a new project (folder <job number>__<Name>), or the design goes into it if the library already has that folder.

VghLantern__DocManagement__Config__NewPr.SectionNote: Copy for the new design modal. Since 15-Oct-2026 a design always lives in a project of the Vale Projects Master Library: the job number finds that job's library projects (and the client's details in the Vale database placeholder), and the user picks one, or adds the job to the library. The job number digit rules themselves live in Na__ValeDatabase__Config.json; the strings here only describe them to the user.
VghLantern__DocManagement__Config__NewPr.JobNumberHint: Enter the 4 or 5 digit Vale job number. The job is looked up in the Vale Projects Master Library, and the client's details in the Vale database.
